    20	def invoke(directory, name, argv, timeout=600, env=None):
    21	    record = dict(argv=[str(x) for x in argv], cwd=str(ROOT), started_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    22	                  omp_environment={k: (env or os.environ).get(k) for k in ['OMP_DYNAMIC','OMP_THREAD_LIMIT','OMP_MAX_ACTIVE_LEVELS','OMP_WAIT_POLICY','OMP_PROC_BIND']})
    23	    dump_new(directory/(name+'_started.json'), record)
    24	    started = time.monotonic()
    25	    try:
    26	        child = subprocess.Popen(record['argv'], cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
    27	                                 text=True, start_new_session=True)
    28	    except OSError as error:
    29	        record.update(exit_code=None,status='unavailable',stdout='',stderr=str(error),wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    30	        dump_new(directory/(name+'.json'),record)
    31	        raise RuntimeError(name+' could not launch: '+str(error)) from error
    32	    try:
    33	        stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=timeout)
    34	        status = 'completed'
    35	    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, KeyboardInterrupt) as error:
    36	        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    37	        try:stdout,stderr=child.communicate(timeout=10)
    38	        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    39	            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL);stdout,stderr=child.communicate()
    40	        status = 'timeout' if isinstance(error,subprocess.TimeoutExpired) else 'interrupted'
    41	    record.update(exit_code=child.returncode, status=status, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    42	    dump_new(directory/(name+'.json'),record)
    43	    print(name, status, 'exit', child.returncode, flush=True)
    44	    if status=='interrupted':raise KeyboardInterrupt
    45	    if status!='completed' or child.returncode!=0:raise RuntimeError(name+' '+status+' exit '+str(child.returncode))
    46	    return record

    52	def snapshot(build_dir, binary, output):
    53	    env = capture_environment.capture(build_dir, 'run_cpu_gpu_pilot.py (same VM CPU/GPU)')
    54	    env['record_kind']='cpu_gpu_pilot_environment';env['workload']='frozen six-dataset pilot'
    55	    env['gpu_status']='see actual fresh device/workspace probes';env['affinity']=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))
    56	    env['load_average']=list(os.getloadavg());env['disk_free_bytes']=shutil.disk_usage(output).free
    57	    paths=['/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max','/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max','/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current',
    58	           '/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_quota_us','/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_period_us',
    59	           '/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu,cpuacct/cpu.cfs_quota_us','/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu,cpuacct/cpu.cfs_period_us',
    60	           '/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes','/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.usage_in_bytes']
    61	    env['resource_files']={p:read_optional(p) for p in paths}
    62	    env['cgroup_mountinfo']=read_optional('/proc/self/mountinfo')
    63	    env['governors']={str(p):read_optional(p) for p in Path('/sys/devices/system/cpu').glob('cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor')}
    64	    env['omp_environment']={k:os.environ.get(k) for k in ['OMP_DYNAMIC','OMP_THREAD_LIMIT','OMP_MAX_ACTIVE_LEVELS','OMP_WAIT_POLICY','OMP_PROC_BIND']}
    65	    env['binary_linkage']=capture_environment.probe(['ldd',str(binary)])
    66	    env['nvidia_smi']=capture_environment.probe(['nvidia-smi'])
    67	    env['gpu_processes']=capture_environment.probe(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'])
    68	    env['gpu_details']=capture_environment.probe(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,uuid,driver_version,memory.total,memory.free,temperature.gpu,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,power.limit','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'])
    69	    env['nvcc']=capture_environment.probe(['nvcc','--version'])
    70	    env['measurement_controls']='frequency/cache/thermal/background exclusivity not controlled; observable checks only'

    73	def environment_gate(environment):
    74	    require(platform.system()=='Linux', 'pilot currently requires Linux')
    75	    require(len(environment['affinity'])>=2,'fewer than two available logical CPUs')
    76	    require(environment['disk_free_bytes']>=1024**3,'less than1GiB free disk')
    77	    memory={line.split(':')[0]:line.split(':')[1].strip() for line in environment['linux_meminfo'].splitlines() if ':' in line}
    78	    require(int(memory['MemAvailable'].split()[0])*1024>=1024**3,'less than1GiB MemAvailable')
    79	    files=environment['resource_files']
    80	    quota=files['/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max']
    81	    if quota and quota.split()[0]!='max':require(int(quota.split()[0])/int(quota.split()[1])>=2,'CPU quota below two CPUs')
    82	    for cpu in ['/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu','/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu,cpuacct']:
    83	        q=files[cpu+'/cpu.cfs_quota_us'];p=files[cpu+'/cpu.cfs_period_us']
    84	        if q and p and int(q)>0:require(int(q)/int(p)>=2,'CPU quota below two CPUs')
    85	    for maximum,current in [('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max','/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current'),
    86	                            ('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes','/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.usage_in_bytes')]:
    87	        limit=files[maximum];used=files[current]
    88	        if limit and limit!='max' and used:require(int(limit)-int(used)>=1024**3,'less than1GiB cgroup memory headroom')
    89	    for name in ['nvidia_smi','gpu_processes','gpu_details','nvcc']:
    90	        require(environment[name].get('returncode')==0,'environment command unavailable: '+name)
    91	    require(not environment['gpu_processes']['stdout'].strip(),'visible competing GPU process; stop before timing')

   107	def validate_prerequisites(path, executable, input_tool, model):
   108	    p=json.loads(path.read_text())
   109	    require(p.get('protocol')==PROTOCOL and p.get('complete') is True,'prerequisite validation incomplete')
   110	    require(p.get('validation_scope','full_protocol_v1')=='full_protocol_v1' and p.get('study_eligible',True) is True,
   111	            'non-timing subset is not full study prerequisites')
   112	    require(p['source_sha256']==verify_source_extension(model)['current_source_sha256'],'source changed after prerequisite validation')
   113	    require(p['binary_sha256']==sha(executable) and p['input_tool_sha256']==sha(input_tool),'binary changed after validation')
   114	    required={'cpu_release_ctest','cpu_sanitize_ctest','cuda_ctest','cuda_correctness','preflight'}
   115	    records=p['records']
   116	    require(required<=set(records),'missing prerequisite commands')
   117	    for name,record in records.items():
   118	        relative=Path(record['file'])
   119	        require(not relative.is_absolute() and '..' not in relative.parts,'unsafe prerequisite record path')
   120	        command_path=path.parent/record['file']
   121	        require(sha(command_path)==record['sha256'],'prerequisite record changed')
   122	        result=json.loads(command_path.read_text())
   123	        require(result['exit_code']==0 and result.get('status')=='completed','failed prerequisite '+name)
   124	    return p
